title: Minigame: C9.3 Spotters

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the C9.3 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): the fewest counters a Spotter needs, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a light mortar and its crew at ground level beside a hill, and a squad that may spot for it from the slope, in the PFPh.

introduction: A light mortar below a hill is given a Spotter on the slope above it.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
